We are located very close to 7th Avenue, which has all kinds of shopping. There are fine groceries such as Union Market, several good delis, some of the best bagels in New York at the Bagel Hole,etc., as well as restaurants with food from every corner of the globe, ranging from higher end fare at places like Talde to our local diner located right on the corner of the block. neighborhood_overview: Location, Location, Location! We are in the middle of it all. Much to see and do in Waikiki. The World's most famous beach is just two short blocks away. Watch the sunsets from nearly any vantage point along the beach and see the Friday night fireworks from the Hilton Hawaiian Village. The nearby neighborhood includes several major hotels and numerous large and small restaurants and nightclubs that cater to every nationality. Ask the kamaaina (locals) for their tips. The Royal Hawaiian Shopping Center and other “World Class Shopping" may be found on Kalakaua Avenue (the street fronting the beach). neighborhood_overview: While our mailing address is Captain Cook, our home is actually located in a rural setting within the village of Kealia, which is the center of a large cattle ranch.  There is nothing between us and the ocean but the ranch land comprised mostly of  tropical forest.  While we have neighbors on both sides, Hale Honu is very private with many plantings and trees on the property lines.  We are mid-way between Hookena Beach State Park to the south, and Place of Refuge National Historic Park to the north, which is adjacent to "Two Step," one of the best snorkeling locations on the Big Island.  The Hookena Beach bay area is also the play ground and resting place for a pod of dolphins that are often seen during early mornings or evenings. It is a ten minute drive to either of these locations, and a short walk to a small convenience store in the central village.  We are 70 miles from Volcano National Park - a 90 minute drive of spectacular scenery.

transit: Hale Honu is 20 miles south of Kailua-Kona and 27 miles from the Kona International Airport.  A rental car is essential.

neighborhood_overview: North Curl Curl, especially up on the headland, is unique as it's one of the quieter beaches with little development (except at either end of the beach).  North Curly has a superb surf beach (probably the best next to Narrabeen for keen surfers, yet safe enough for beginners too).  You can walk down to Curl Curl beach & Dee Why beach in minutes, & of course there are the superb restaurants along Dee Why beachfront to enjoy.  If you are reasonably fit you would enjoy the cliff top hike between North Curl Curl Surf Club & Dee Why beach, & of course you can also enjoy the superb walk from North Curl Curl to Manly (45-60 minutes walk), which meanders along beaches, through landscaped parks & a stunning boardwalk.

transit: Bus transport connections are superb for Manly, the city & Chatswood, which you can access at the bottom of our road.  No need to worry about finding a parking spot near the beach - you can just walk to either Curl Curl or Dee Why beaches from the Garden Room in just a matter of minutes!
access: You will have your own independent access through the back entrance sliding doors (watch out for the friendly golden retriever), with a large sunny back deck for your private use to enjoy leisurely breakfasts overlooking our garden while listening to our chickens.  You also have exclusive use of a large sumptuous & contemporary ensuite bathroom.
interaction: We will most likely be home but sometimes we are away - you may well not see us even if we are home as you have your own independent access to the Garden Room.  Of course if we are home, then please do wander upstairs to ask us any questions you may have.

neighborhood_overview: About the NEIGHBORHOOD:::      The neighborhood is Flatbush, bordering Ditmas Park and Prospect-Lefferts Gardens. This is NOT hipster paradise, and it's NOT gangster's paradise either!  Our neighborhood is very residential and typically quieter than most urban cities. The summertime is louder on the block because very few people have air conditioning and enjoy hanging outside. The neighbors are friendly, so say hello as you pass! neighborhood_overview: Source: Wikipédia Depuis les années 1980, le Mile End est connu comme un quartier à vocation largement artistique, peuplé par des artistes, des musiciens, des écrivains et des cinéastes. On y retrouve de nombreuses galeries d'art, des ateliers de designers, des boutiques et des cafés. L'entreprise de logiciels d'infographie 3D Discreet Logic a marqué le quartier en rénovant un étage d'une ancienne usine de textiles au début des années 1990. En 1997, cet espace devient les nouveaux studios montréalais du développeur de jeux vidéo Ubisoft, agrandis par la suite pour occuper la majeure partie de l'immeuble. Le Mile End est nettement plus fortuné et plus populaire depuis le milieu des années 1990 : l'augmentation des loyers et l'apparition de nouvelles boutiques haut de gamme en témoignent. Récemment, le Mile End fut considéré par plusieurs magazines musicaux spécialisés, notamment Spin et Pitchfork, comme le cœur de la scène musicale indépendante de Montréal. transit: TRANSPORT By Bus--One of the best deals anywhere, TheBus will take you around the whole island for $2.50 ($1.25 for children age 6–17)—if you have time. If you’re planning on sticking to the Waikiki–Ala Moana–Downtown region, go with TheBus, which will save you a lot of car hassle and expense. The no. 19 (Airport/Hickam), no. 20 (Airport/Halawa Gate), and no. 40 (Waipahu/Ala Moana) also cover the same stretch. Waikiki service begins daily at 5am and runs until midnight; most buses run about every 15 minutes during the day and every 30 minutes in the evening. neighborhood_overview: One of Sydney’s grandest suburbs, Mosman is located just 8kms from the CBD over the Sydney Harbour Bridge. It’s a suburb many aspire to live in and once you’re there, there’s little reason to leave, with plenty of shops along Military Road, stunning scenery and even the iconic Taronga Zoo to keep you amused. Balmoral Beach offers a more relaxed atmosphere, with parks, swimming and beachside cafes. It’s tempting to stay at home and get lost in the harbour view from your balcony, but at some point it’s important to leave the house. A walk through Mosman is an excellent workout due to the inevitable hill-climbing challenges. There’s a community bus for short trips and plenty of buses into the CBD; or the ferry if you prefer a water crossing. Small clumps of village shops include delicatessens, bakeries and specialty gift stores, while the major shopping precinct is located on Military Road.

neighborhood_overview: Tamarama is the younger, arguably prettier, sister to Bondi Beach. It's a relatively quiet beach where locals spend hours bathing in the sun. There is a park here with BBQs, toilets, changing rooms and a large grassy area to make a picnic. GREAT OCEAN WALK While you're in the area, you must take the Great Ocean Walk. It's a pathway that hugs the coast line all the way from Bondi to Coogee beach. Thankfully, it crosses your doorstep. Just join the throngs of people making the pilgrimage every day. SCULPTURES BY THE SEA Every year artists erect a series of sculptures along the Great Ocean Walk. It's a magical display set against the ocean views along the walk and it attracts thousands of local people and others from around the world. This year it is happening from 24 October - 10 November.
notes: FREE BOTTLE OF CHAMPAGNE We want you to have a great time when you stay at our place. We like the idea of you sitting out on the balcony celebrating something and admiring the view. So, anyone that books for 3 nights or more will find a bottle of Veuve Cliquot in the fridge upon arrival. SAVING LIVES We are really thankful to live by the beach and it's a stunning beach. One of the things that makes this beach a great place to swim and have fun in summer are the lifesavers who volunteer their time to look after the people who use the beach. Chances are that you've chosen our place partly because of the beach out the front. So to thank the guys that look after the beach for us, 10% of everything that you pay to us will be given to them as a donation. It's the least we can do for the guys that keep the beach safe. We'll send you a copy of the receipt and any comments that we get from them in thanks.
transit: BUSES The local area is serviced by buses that will take you to other transport hubs that will take you anywhere you need to go or you can catch a local bus directly to the CBD and be there in about 15 minutes. You'll have access to the internet from the computer set up for you in the apartment. Just either call 131500 and ask them for help or search 131500 on a search engine and you'll find a website showing all the timetables. You're not too far from anywhere!
access: All guests will have free access to all the amenities and facilities in the Apartment. This includes a coffee machine, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, 434 litre fridge, a complete library of books, 54" TV & DVD Player, wireless broadband internet, sound system and an intercom / security system. TRANSPORT Once you arrive at The BEACHFRONT Apartment you probably won't want to leave. But should the need arise, there is transport immediately out the front. The #361 bus stop is across the ride and it will take you to Bondi Junction or Bondi Beach. From the Junction you can catch buses and trains to the city. The bus is handy, however, most things are within walking distance anyway.

interaction: We love to talk about our favorite places, activities and foods to eat here on the North Shore, but if you prefer to adventure on your own,  you'll find lots of information in the Guest Book. house_rules: Hawaiian style:  1) ALL FOOTWEAR STAYS DOWNSTAIRS, on the tiled area. That means shoes, slippers, sandals, flip-flops/thongs (but don't say that in Hawaii, we call 'em SLIPPAHS!), reef-walkers, slip-ons, Crocs, etc.  2) RINSE OFF ALL SAND BEFORE ENTERING THE HOUSE. Chances are, if you survived the pounding shore break at Waimea, you got a load of sand in your bathing suit. This will clog up the plumbing in the shower, so PLEASE leave the sand at the beach or rinse out your suits with the hose before entering the studio. 3) Do not hang beach towels on balcony. DO hang them on the clothesline downstairs. 4) Do not use the white bath towels for food spills, muddy feet or makeup removal, etc. That's what the rags (under the kitchen and bathroom sinks) and black wash towels are for!   5) No extra guests. 6) RESPECT the ocean. NEVER turn your back on her. If in doubt, don't go out. Swim at beaches that have a lifeguard nearby.

There is road noise from cars driving by, something to consider if you are sensitive to neighborhood noises.
notes: Mokuleia is on the more remote end of the North Shore and offers something for everyone:  hiking to Kaʻena Natural Area Reserve home to the native endangered Hawaiian Monk Seal which you can observe (from a distance!), Laysan Albatross, tide pools, rare native coastal plants, and a breathtaking view to the other side of the island at the end of the hike. The Mokuleia Polo Field is footsteps from the studio. Dillingham Airfield,  1 minute down the road, offers adrenalin junkies skydiving with breath taking views of Mt. Kaʻala and the coast. Or just relax on any of the Mokuleia beaches nearby.

Waialua a smaller community five minutes away, has a local coffee shop, pizzeria, small grocery store with lots of fresh produce, Saturday Farmers' Market at the Old Sugar Mill, and the Waialua Bandstand were you can enjoy a Sunday performance the first Sunday of each month by local and national performers. There is also a post office and gas station. The airport is 45 minutes away.

The light rail is a 10 - 15 minutes walk away in Lewisham and provides convenient access to Star City, Paddy's markets, China Town and the Fish Markets. neighborhood_overview: Not long ago, I overheard a conversation between a middle-aged French-Canadian couple standing on Moon Street, guidebook in hand. "Apparently, this is one of the last authentic neighbourhoods left," said one of them, looking around. "You know, with little shops and low density, as opposed to all those giant monstrosities you see everywhere else." It wasn't an unfair assessment. Through a quirk of geography, Star, Sun, Moon and St Francis streets have become an island of tranquility in a congested city. Even as the high-rises encroach, the neighbourhood's dead-end streets, narrow alleyways and leafy squares retain their quietude, a quality complemented by an eclectic range of businesses that see the area's calm as an asset. "All of this makes the neighbourhood very precious," says architect Christopher Law.

neighborhood_overview: Kailua-Kona is a quaint town on the west coast of the Big Island of Hawaii.  With bustling shops, fun activities, and year-around sunshine this is the perfect place to come and enjoy a relaxing vacation.    Kona is world famous for its gin-clear deep-blue waters. Kona means "lee" in Hawaiian and the region enjoys a dry, sunny climate with limited run off creating rich reefs and amazing visibility. We have some of the best diving and snorkeling in Hawaii right off our shores and steps from Surf Temple.

neighborhood_overview: O Méier é um bairro tradicional do subúrbio carioca, antigo centro da região histórica da “Área dos Engenhos”. O bairro se desenvolveu e abrigou boa parte da classe média alta do Rio de Janeiro até os anos 50. Entre os seus moradores ilustres estão o escritor Milôr Fernandes e o sambista João Nogueira. Atualmente ele possui uma vida bastante agitada e pulsante, de dia e de noite, com o seu ritmo bastante característico. O bairro tem tudo para a comodidade do hóspede: bancos academias, teatro, cinema, casa de espetáculos, lojas de rua e Shopping Center. A gastronomia é bastante variada, tendo opções para todos os gostos. Nossa sugestão é a Casa do Bacalhau, onde se pode apreciar as iguarias preparadas com este fruto do mar acompanhado de um bom vinho. Para aqueles que apreciam o bom futebol, estamos a 5min do Engenhão e 15min do Maracanã. A noite pode ser aproveitada no baixo Méier, onde temos diversas opções de bares.

Countless TV show and films set in NYC or BK has been filmed, at least in part, in Bed Stuy, often transforming the streets into a scene from the late 1800's because that's when all of these homes were built! Boardwalk Empire, The Knick and countless other shows are filmed here.  We've got a great selection of hip restaurants and cafes in the neighborhood and one of NYC's finest restaurants, Saraghina, is just around the corner. We've also got a French restaurant just on the next block!  There is a bustling shopping area on Broadway, where you will usually take the train, so you can food shop on your way home from a long day's adventure! neighborhood_overview: Palm Beach, affectionately known as 'Palmy', is situated at the end of Barrenjoey Peninsula, less than an hour's drive from Sydney Harbour Bridge, the Opera House and the CBD. Palm Beach is blessed with a unique contrast of lush evergreen bushland and beaches of golden sand, and enveloped by the pristine waters of the Pacific Ocean and the calm sailing paradise of Pittwater. Just a short boat ride and a packed lunch and you're able to enjoy some of the most beautiful and isolated beaches in Sydney.
transit: Palm Beach is accessible by a few different methods, the most interesting of which is by Sea plane, either Sydney Seaplanes or Sydney by Seaplane are able to get you there safely. From Sydney airport you can pre book a shuttle bus, try My Shuttle or ASN or grab a taxi or Uber for the fastest journey door to door. If you have time on your side, there's a train to the city and then the L90 bus to Palm Beach.

neighborhood_overview: Around Casa Flores good wine, good food, the most traditional products and all the essentials, the best view, the romantic walks and the main touristic landmarks are guaranteed. Still it is also a quiet residential area, accessible, in the heart of Old Gaia, 10 minutes walking distance from Porto historical centre and 30 minutes away from the beach by public transport. In the streets that surround Casa Flores you will smell the aroma of the worldwide famous nectar, Port Wine. If your going for a tasting you just need to walk out the front door and go for a few metres to the most renowned cellars: Offley, Sandeman, Calém, Ferreirinha, etc. And if you enjoy good food as much as good wine try the typical restaurants in the neighbouring streets. Or you can always buy some genuine produce in the grocery stores next door, take it home and cook your own portuguese inspired meal.
transit: We suggest that you walk and explore the surroundings, go across the river through the D. Luiz I bridge, get on the old tram to the beach in Porto or get a bus to the beaches in Gaia. You can also enjoy the view over the city by cablecar. Our location is perfect to travel by bus, boat or walking. And if you want to go a little bit further you can also get a train (10 minutes walking distance) and discover other precious gems in the region.

O nome faz referência a uma região em Sorocaba, onde José Antônio Moreira Filho ((PHONE NUMBER HIDDEN)), feito segundo barão de Ipanema em 1847 (e conde em 1868), tinha uma metalúrgica. Nessa mesma região, havia a Real Fábrica de Ferro São João do Ipanema, aos pés do Morro de Ipanema. Era um minerador e comprou as terras onde hoje está localizado o bairro carioca e decidiu homenagear seu local de nascimento, a vila de São João de Ipanema, hoje pertencente a cidade de Iperó. História O desenvolvimento da Zona Sul foi forçado pela chegada da corte portuguesa no século XIX, quando a população da cidade (capital na ocasião) passou de sessenta mil para quinhentos mil habitantes. neighborhood_overview: We have loved living on Kapaau Road for over 44 years with friendly neighbors,just far enough away to feel very private  in our own "special corner of paradise". You can take a walk or a jog,or sit under our trees(not with coconuts),swing in our hammock,sit on our decks and relax. We are just a few minutes walk from the quaint historic town of Kapaau which holds an authentic paniolo "cowboy and pa' u riders " parade celebrating the birthday of King Kamehameha,whose famous statue is on our corner. North Kohala has a fabulous Country Fair in October,Chinese Lion dances in February and many musical and cultural events at nearby Kamehameha Park
notes: We will be adding a 14.25% Hawaii hotel tax to your bill which we will ask for when you arrive. We will let you know the tax amount when the bill is finalized. This can be paid to us by  check, money order, cash or credit card.  ******The standard $50 cleaning fee is valid for up to a one week rental.  ******Please note: additional cleaning fees at a rate of $30 to 50 per week will be added for longer stays and based on number of days and number of people.  This additional fee will be due with the Hawaii Tax and due on arrival.****** We are a Bed and Beauty but you can do some light cooking. The Sundeck Suite has a garden-view kitchenette, where you can prepare what you want to eat breakfast at home,prepare picnics, order "take out" from excellent cafes and watch a movie,or enjoy  magnificent sunsets on the fantastic deck. The Cozy and Garden have small appliances,food prep and dining areas. We do have a washing machine, clothesline, iron, available, and a dryer if necessary. All rooms
transit: You really do need a rental car to get the most out of North Kohala,though we have had several bicycling andy motorcycling guests. There is public transportation about 1/4 mile away,early in the morning and returning  late afternoon.(Waimea,Hilo,South Kohala resorts,Kailua Kona. Cabs are costly, but walking's a possibility to many nearby places of interest if one's without a car for part of the day while traveling partner is on business or has special interests needing the vehicle.
access: Guests can walk down our hill to eclectic shops,galleries,cafes, great public park with gym, swimming pool,tennis,golf and playground. Barbecue or picnic in our garden setting. Play basket ball,ping pong or volleyball or look through our telescope. Direct TV and usually adequate  wifi, soon to be upgraded to cable.(finally coming to our"neck of the woods"). Fix your own meals with small appliances or order from yummy nearby cafes. Play basketball,ping pong,ask us to schedule a massage, infrared sauna,ukulele,guitar, hula ,art  or culinary lesson; be creative, adventurous,listen to some of Hawaii's best local musicians, or just relax.
interaction: We enthusiastically help you plan your time in  our fantastic North Kohala and incredible  Big Island, as we have lived here for 40 awesome years. We try to be available at any time  should you have any concerns. We want guests to have all the "peace and relaxation" and privacy possible, but love to share moments as desired and time allows.
house_rules: Our usual policy is a 3 night minimum because there is so much to see and do here and within easy,scenic drives, but we will do our best to accommodate you for one or two nights. This is a smoke free guesthouse but there are lots of open spaces . It's usually pretty quiet here, especially after 10 or 11 pm,unless we're all having a good time together. We have had 95% wonderful experiences with fantastic guests from all over the world. It's Hawaii's custom to remove your shoes when entering. We ask that everyone be considerate,try to be quiet(no dancing on the Sundeck with loud shoes) after 10 pm and before 9 am, unless we all agree to have a party to watch the full moon!

neighborhood_overview: We are technically in Kukuihaele, at the edge of Waipio Valley ("Valley of the Kings") The closest small town, Honoka'a (small fresh food grocer, movie theatre, emergency room, individually-owned restaurants and shops, etc) is 9 miles up the road, and the larger town of Waimea (small airport, hardware store, larger grocer and hospital) is a 30-minute drive. The larger towns of Hilo and Kona, each with international airports, are both approximately one hour away. For the most part the closest place to grab a bite is Honokaa. ("For the most part" because there are sometimes roadside food places open during the day closer to Waipio. Also, the Waipio Cookhouse is now open for lunch and dinner: Farm to table casual dining. Just 0.75 mi up the road. Try it out!) Our quaint neighborhood is remarkably safe.
notes: It rains here on occasion...bring a rain jacket or poncho if you own one. We can also dig up extras if needed though. A 4-WD is helpful if you plan to explore all that Waipio valley has to offer. Of course, it can be done on foot as well. Sometimes we drive down for a surf, swim, or hike. If so come along and hitch a ride! Volcano/Lava/Vog-  You're safe and in a great location here. We are 55+ miles from any lava flows, and enjoy the cleanest air on the entire island typically because of our northern/windward location.  Coqui frogs - they are certainly a presence after dark and can be boisterous little guys at night. White noise for some, more bothersome for others. If likely the latter, consider white noise apps and/or ear plugs to drown out the nature. Earthquakes - we occasionally have some small tremblers!
transit: Car is best, but buses are reliable into Honokaa from Kona/Hilo sides. From there you'll need a ride though. Plenty of people hitchhike (including ourselves).
access: Access is to the entire guest suite, adjacent to but completely separate from our main home.
interaction: Happy to greet you and show you in if you so desire. Otherwise, we will leave you to enjoy the space and property on your own.
house_rules: - No shoes inside please. Please remove footwear before entering the ohana. (Black sand and clay/dirt are virtually impossible to get out of carpet, whether from shoes or feet) -  Please do not bring plants, muds, or soils of any sort onto the property. "Little Fire Ants" or LFAs are a dangerous invasive species, and make ecosystems uninhabitable.  Thanks for understanding. We want to make sure all future guests are able to have an equally pleasant experience!

No século XX começam a surgir os palacetes com os seus belos azulejos, que abrigavam a Burguesia portuense e casas de funcionários das fábricas. É na Rua do Bonfim, nº 234, um prédio dos anos 50 que hoje dá lugar ao Bonfim 234 Townhouse.  A área do Bonfim está a tornar-se numa área moderna onde tem surgido novos projetos entre galerias de artes, cafés, companhias de teatro. neighborhood_overview: Upcountry Waimea (Kamuela on Hawaii Island, the Big Island) is cooler in temperature by about 10 degrees Fahrenheit, when compared to Kailua-Kona, where the airport (KOA) is located. The green grass and rolling hills with grazing cattle remind people of foothills, however from parts of the town, you can still see the ocean, as well as Mauna Kea. At 13,803 ft, Mauna Kea, almost a "fourteener," is draped in a cloak of snow at times in the winter.  It's a 3 minute drive from Tootsie's Hideaway to the coffee shop and other shopping, only two minutes more to the grocery store. The energetic can ask me directions for a low-traffic route to the coffee shop and unique gift stores, or to the Nature Park for a relaxing stroll.  Summer it is generally 70 - 85 degrees Fahrenheit (21 - 29 degrees Celsius). Winter varies from 55 - 70 degrees Fahrenheit (13 - 21 degrees Celsius). (I will wash, dry & fold your laundry but may need at least 24 hours if I'm working. Please check with me.)
transit: Waimea is fairly central on the island. It takes just under an hour by car from  the airport (KOA) in Kailua-Kona to drive to Waimea. From Waimea it takes about 20 minutes by car to get to the beach and 30 minutes to reach Hawi on the northernmost tip of the island, and just over an hour to get to the historic town of Hilo.  It is best to rent a car at the airport in Kailua-Kona. Although there are some buses on the island, the time schedules cater to those working at the resorts.

There is a Storage Service in the Laundromat below this building (Sydney Laundry @ 234 Elizabeth St). Costs are definitely the cheapest in Sydney CBD: only $2/day for small bag, $5-6/day for large luggage. Another options: Across the road at Central Station called Smart Carte (5 minutes walk) or World Square Shopping Centre (4 minutes walk).

I or a trusted friend will be available leading up to and during your stay to answer any questions you may have.

This gorgeous shoreline is a mecca for couples and families alike with shower facilities, barbecues, a childrens' playground and terrific surfing conditions. The Dee Why SLSC patrol the beach each day. A fantastic bushwalk over the headland provides some sweeping views across the Tasman. If you need a break from the beach sun, head across the street and grab a table at any one of the many local restaurants or cafés with a great view of the surf instead. Nesting above La Distillerie No.2, one of our 3 cocktail pubs in the city, Le Bed & Cocktail is located in a vibrant and trendy neighbourhood, the Plateau Mont-Royal.
space: We have twelve pods located in two rooms (one with 4 pods & one with 8 pods). Each pod has a night light, integrated ventilation, a curtain that allows you to close off your pod space completely, and storage for your luggage (lock not included). The shared space is an entirely renovated apartment with a communal kitchen, a lounge with board games, LEGOs and musical instruments, a computer and printer, 3 bathrooms, 3 showers, heated floors and a patio in the back. Here's a nice opportunity to live together with new friends visiting Montreal!

Round it off with a wealth of interesting shops, cafés, pubs and bars, not to forget black-box theatres, art galleries and gourmet shops, and you’ve got a free-spirited, creative atmosphere where all walks of life converge. It was here that the sultan’s soldiers used to train their target, hence its name – Nisantasi means “target stone “ .Taksim Square is the center of Istanbul today, and Beyoglu has a very nice pedestrian street.  Besiktas is the best place to observe the lively Istanbul city life. It is also the popular meeting point as well as the most important junction for sea transportation. Besiktas also hosts the historical heritage of the Ottomans, culture and art with its Dolmabahce, Ciragan and Yildiz Palace. Besiktas is also one of the best places to see in Istan

Watch the sunsets from nearly any vantage point along the beach and see the Friday night fireworks from the Hilton Hawaiian Village. The major bus stops are all on Kuhio Avenue less than a 5 minute walk from the unit.

neighborhood_overview: Sok Kwu Wan is an ancient fishing village (dating back over 5,000 years) with a population of around 300 people. In Sok Kwu Wan town you can find a few local stores where they sell simple snacks and drinks. There's no convenience stores on this side of the island but numbers of reputed waterfront seafood restaurants. We have our favourites and will gladly share our local knowledge to make your stay more enjoyable. They all face to the west so waterfront sunset meals can be spectacular (see photos). Lamma island is geographically divided into 2 almost even parts. We are situated in the centre providing great hiking to the remote southern section with its remote white sand beaches and Hong Kong's only Green Sea Turtle breeding sanctuary.  The north of the island (Yung She Wan) boasts a larger population with shops, banks, organic food stores, restaurants and bars about a 50 minute hike on a paved (concrete) path. There’s no inter-island ferry between the south and the north of the island
notes: Living on an island just 35 minutes by ferry to one of the busiest cities in the world has upsides and down.  We do not have any local supermarkets, so ensure you have a daily supply of basics. Obviously we are prepared and usually have most 'stuff' that you would need. Since we are away from the main path, getting to the house can be tricky. We will send you a map to show you how to get to the house from Sok Kwu Wan pier later.
transit: There are no roads on Lamma Island. There is a beautiful 5 km bike ride to the remote southern beaches and Green Sea Turtle hatchery. Additionally, there are many easy, moderate and difficult hiking trails that will keep the outdoors person entertained for days.  The ferry to Hong Kong Island (Central & Aberdeen) departs every 90 minutes (approx) from Sok Kwu Wan and about every 45 minutes from Yung Shue Wan (the northern ferry terminal).
access: Bedroom and adjacent bathroom (including bath), you are most welcome to use all common areas including the G/F lounge, kitchen and outdoor garden.  Guests have free access to kayak hire (and fishing gear) at a substantially reduced rate. We provide simple breakfast, such as jam & toast, muesli/oatmeal and coffee/tea/milk, water filter is installed in the kitchen where you can refill your water bottle. We encourage our guest not to buy single use plastic bottles for drinking water, we can provide you a reuseable water bottle if you need.  You are always welcome to let us know (at least 24 hours notice in advance) if you want something different or other meal(s) you want it/them to be prepared and all cost based on request.  Laundry (washing and drying) service can be provided with a small fee.
interaction: As professional tour operators and outdoor educators we are able to provide informed and practical information for any visitor to Hong Kong. However, we also appreciate our own space, so understand that you will too, which means we are there if you need or want our company or information.

name: Hawaiian Jungle Hut
space: Hawaiian Jungle Hut is the ohana next to Hawaiian Jungle Hangout with a separate entrance.  Rustic and cute, the hut is perfect for a couple or single guest who need a home base while exploring the island. Having it's own full bathroom, living room, inside washer and dryer, and kitchenette with tiki bar.  The hut is also wireless and cable connected.  No phone and no stove.  There is a shared outside gas grill.   Three miles from the ocean, and a mile from the main highway, Hawaiian Jungle Hut offers easy access to eastside highlights--20 minutes from Ahalanui Beach Park (a naturally warmed 95 degree seawater pond), 35 minutes from Volcano National Park, 20 minutes from Hilo airport, 10 minutes from Keaau town, and 10 minutes from Pahoa Village. Este moderno y equipado estudio está diseñado para garantizar una estancia cómoda y confortable. Se accede por el hall de entrada, encontrándose justo a un lado, el walk-in closet. Seguidamente se accede a un espacio abierto donde encontramos el dormitorio que se halla separado del resto del estudio por una pared que linda con la cocina. La cama doble del dormitorio puede dividirse en dos camas individuales de 90cm x 200cm y dispone de mesitas de noche con luz e iluminación de lectura. Tras el dormitorio se encuentra el espacio general comprendido por la cocina integrada y la sala, donde podremos cocinar, leer, mirar TV o relajarse en el gran sofá que se halla en la sala. Este sofá puede convertirse en cama doble alojando así 2 huéspedes más. El baño presenta una ducha a nivel
neighborhood_overview: El estudio se localiza en pleno centro de Barcelona cerca de los puntos de interés más famosos de la ciudad.  A únicamente 10 minutos a pie se encuentra la histórica Sagrada Familia. A la misma distancia se localiza también el Arco de Triunfo seguido del maravilloso Parque de la Ciutadella. Por otro lado, la popular Avinguda Diagonal está a 5 minutos andando del alojamiento. Ésta avenida es una de las más importantes de Barcelona conjuntamente con el Passeig de Gràcia i Las Ramblas.  Todos estos puntos ofrecen una gran variedad de comercios, restaurantes y ocio para disfrutar al máximo de esta impresionante ciudad.
notes: En este mismo edificio disponemos de más alojamientos parecidos para 1 y hasta 4 personas. No dudes en escribirnos un mensaje si estas interesado.

The bathroom is bright and includes an internal washing machine. There is a great shared rooftop that has a glimpse (totally just a glimpse) of the Harbour Bridge. Particularly visible during winter when the leaves on the trees out front have fallen.

You'll love walking just 1 minute to an excellent bar or restaurant, 4 minutes to our local grocer or take your pick of heaps of coffee options for a caffeine hit! This apartment has a fully equipped kitchen with induction stove set in our beloved reclaimed railway sleeper bench top. The bedroom is separated from the lounge with an exposed brick wall (something that came as an accident during the renovation but we loved and kept!) and a sliding door for privacy. The bathroom is bright and includes an internal washing machine. There is a great shared rooftop that has a glimpse (totally just a glimpse) of the Harbour Bridge. Particularly visible during winter
neighborhood_overview: Potts Point AKA Kings Cross has been through some interesting changes in the past 3-5 years. These days it's less about the clubs and pubs and more about the restaurants, apartments and shops. You'll find heaps of options for coffee and cocktails. This apartment is 4 minutes walk from Kings Cross Station (and the famous Coke sign), 6 minutes walk from Woolloomooloo, 15 minutes from The Art Gallery of NSW and The Royal Botanic Gardens and just 25 minutes walk from Martin Place (about the centre of the city.
notes: Note that some of the furniture & artwork has changed since these photos were taken. Namely there is a new Tv unit and TV as well as the bedside tables are different.
transit: You really should walk everywhere from here if you can - it's the best way to get around! Otherwise, being 4 minutes from Kings Cross Station you are about 20 minutes on Public Transport from Darling Harbour or Circular Quay, 30 minutes on Public Transport from Bondi Beach and the same (30 minutes) from the domestic & international terminals at Sydney Airport. Ubers or Taxis are a cinch but parking isn't great so I wouldn't recommend being here with a car. That said, there is a paid parking station nearby or you can try stalking a car for their spot!
access: Guests have access to the whole apartment as well as all common areas in the building which mainly just includes the rooftop (and foyer & bin room - yay!).
interaction: There is a lockbox to fetch the keys so guests will be self-sufficient from check-in (unless I'm nearby at the time to meet you...if you're lucky!). I am always available on email/text if anything is required or you need advice. As a host, I expect guests to communicate their arrival and departure at the least. I like to check-in with guests during their stay via the Aibnb messages to ensure everything is going smoothly with your stay.

neighborhood_overview: While Şişli (read as Sheshly) is often regarded as one of the upscale districts in Istanbul, there’s a lot more to it than just 5 star hotels and shopping malls. For a taste of Turkish culture, you can find impressive museums, churches and mosques all around this opulent district. Going to Şişli really is an experience of contemporary Turkish life.  You can see;  Atatürk Museum (Atatürk Müzesi), located on Halaskargazi Street, Atatürk Museum is a three story house museum painted in pink. Atatürk, the founder and the first President of the Republic of Turkey, first used the house for storage and residential purposes, but it was later changed to a museum to exhibit some of the personal belongings of Atatürk and depict his lifetime through historical documents and photographs. Since Atatürk did actually live and work in the house during significant historical events like the War of Independence and invasion of Istanbul, you will have a true experience of Atatürk’s life and Turkish history

neighborhood_overview: La Barceloneta es un barrio marinero del distrito de Ciutat Vella de Barcelona.Actualmente, el barrio sigue teniendo ese aire de pueblo ajeno a la ciudad que siempre le ha caracterizado. Pero el ambiente ha cambiado mucho, sobre todo, en verano. Su playa es una de las más animadas de la ciudad tanto de día como de noche, cuando abren los chiringuitos y bares musicales instalados en la misma arena donde se puede ir a cenar o a tomar una copa hasta altas horas de la madrugada.Junto a esta cara moderna, la Barceloneta sigue oliendo a sal y a ambiente marinero. Para muchos es todo un lujo que todavía se conserve un barrio de este tipo en una ciudad como Barcelona. Y es que resulta algo extraño que junto a calles estrechas, húmedas y ennegrecidas por el salitre, convivan alguno de los mejores restaurantes de la ciudad y atraquen lujosos barcos.

neighborhood_overview: Strathfield is a suburb in the Inner West of Sydney, Australia. It is located 12 kilometres west of the Sydney central business district. Strathfield's residential landscape is extremely varied, ranging from country-style estates to high-rise apartments. Many styles of architecture have been employed over past decades, with dwellings having been constructed in Victorian, Federation, Interwar period architecture, Californian Bungalow and contemporary periods. One of the oldest surviving houses built in the 1870s is Fairholm which is now a retirement village called Strathfield Gardens. Strathfield is known as a regional centre for education.

You will enjoy strolling the different art galleries and shops and if your stay happens to be on the first Friday of the month, don’t miss Holualoa’s  First Friday event when the village comes alive with food booths and music from 5 to 8pm. The drive to Kona town is about 15 minutes. The Airport is a 20 minute drive away. The  closet beach is Magic Sands, about 10 minutes away.
notes: This home is very open with mostly screens for windows and no locks on the doors . The bedroom with the full bed is the only room in the house with actual glass windows and a lock . We love this open feeling and enjoy being so close to the outdoors .  We do not lock our house . The area is very safe.  Our home is decorated with several beautiful Buddha and Ganesh statues. There is no air conditioning at this property. The temperature is very comfortable but fans are available if needed in the summer and extra blankets for chilly nights . If you are just 2 guests but require separate beds we will charge an extra $20 for the 2nd bedroom.  Massage is available on site per request. If arranged ahead of time we offer pick up and drop off to and from the airport for a fee of $30 each way.
transit: It’s always good to have a car whilst on the Big Island for exploring. There is plenty of free parking on the property. We do have Uber now on the Island and you could manage with just that if you plan on staying close to Kona town . An Uber fair to town and back would cost around $25. Strolling through Holualoa just 5 minutes away  is a lovely and relaxing thing to do on your vacation.  You can get a taxi to and from the airport, or there is an option for us to pick you up or drop you off for a fee of $25 if planned in advance.
access: You will have access to the 2 adjoined bedrooms, the kitchen, living room, bathroom, and your own private entrance and porch. The kitchen, bathroom  and living room area will be shared minimally with your hosts during your stay .
interaction: Your hosts sleep on the property in a detached yurt . They will share the kitchen and bathroom with you during your stay. Lulie and John are very approachable and will be happy to answer any questions and do what they can to make your stay enjoyable. They enjoy interacting with guests but are happy to give their guests space if that is what they prefer. Their friendly dogs Bambino and Zorro and two cats hang out at the outside property. The house is pet free inside .
house_rules: No shoes to be worn in the house. Wash dirty dishes or place in dishwasher. Please keep shared spaces clean and tidy, as you find them . Please keep all personnel items in the bedrooms since the living area is shared with your hosts . The pets are to stay outside. Please do not check in early without communicating to us. Please try and let us know what time you will be checking in, so that we can be there to welcome you.

Kealakekua Bay (meaning "Pathway of the Gods") provides great ocean activities such as kayaking, world-class snorkeling, swimming, paddle boarding, surfing, and views of incredible Kona Coast sunsets.  There are a few beaches nearby, all of which have a different vibe and focus:  Manini, Ke'ei, 2 Step and Hookena. We have many recommendations for day trips to Northern hikes and white sandy beaches or other Big Island Adventures.  (see guidebook upon check-in)

name: 贝壳—香港繁华中宁静的休憩小筑
summary: 这是一间温馨的小屋,拥有着三个房间,其中两间是屋主的私人空间｡还有一间拥有独立私密睡房是您的私人领地｡它有一张1.5米的双人床,适合最多2个人拥有一晚舒适的睡眠｡我们很高兴的跟您共同享用我们精心打造的,有一点点old fasion的客厅和餐厅｡客厅和餐厅的木质家具都是我们精心从世界各地淘来的老家具,譬如说樟木箱子作为茶几,长条桌是有50多年的美国家具,另一侧的中式柜子则是花梨木的｡德式的餐桌厚实简单,谁也想不到它已经有过百年的历史,它的所有者是一个德国的老奶奶,我猜想在这个餐桌上,上演了无数次温馨的家庭聚会和老奶奶亲手做的德国美食吧! 屋主喜欢上世纪70年代美国乡村风的室内装饰,所以墙纸采用了具有时代特色的湖蓝色和枫叶黄的主色调,会客厅和餐厅的照明采用了古典彩色拼装玻璃的乡村风格以及温暖的蜡烛｡在我们忙碌和疲劳的一天后,三五知己坐在会客厅享受一杯红酒,可以舒缓一天的疲乏｡ 在会客厅的条案和橱柜上,我们放置了一些从全球各地搜罗来的小物品,虽然价值不高,但是可以跟朋友一起分享我们的旅途和趣事｡

The garden is fertilised by organic compost produced in both compost bins and worm farms. We have Australian native stingless bees that are kept away from the studio that help pollinate the garden. This means that we don't use any pesticides in the garden as we don't want to harm the bees.

neighborhood_overview: Eixample is a beautiful area of the city which includes some of the most popular attractions and iconic monuments in Barcelona. This district lies in the center of Barcelona, above Ciutat Vella and below the district of Gràcia. Running through the heart of Eixample is the famed Passeig de Gràcia, a long thoroughfare that houses some of Barcelona’s most exclusive shopping and is home to some of Gaudí’s most famous works like Casa Batlló and Casa Milà. At the end, you will come to Plaça Catalunya, one of the most visited places in Barcelona. Another monument that should not be missed in Eixample is La Sagrada Família, possibly the most recognized building in Barcelona and an icon of the city. With so much to see and do, no wonder Eixample is so popular!

neighborhood_overview: Tucked away behind the hustle and bustle of Causeway Bay, the Tai Hang neighborhood offers a laid-back alternative to all the buzz. Slow-paced yet rapidly evolving, the enclave is home to a wellspring of restaurants, vintage stores, artisanal coffee shops, and a growing lineup of design-driven boutiques.  A wander around the neighborhood will take you past the 19th-century Lin Fa Temple, sporting graceful eaves and a unique octagonal front hall. It’s here where the annual Fire Dragon Dance takes place during Mid-Autumn Festival, usually in September. A centuries-old ritual, the traditional dance features some 300 performers with incense sticks and firecrackers—believed to extinguish bad luck. Behind the temple, Lin Fa Kung Garden provides a peaceful resting spot. Nearby Victoria Park, just a few minutes’ walk northwest, offers jogging paths, tennis courts, shady corners, and Tai Chi sessions every morning.

Conveniently, these are where a cluster of merchants sell one type of product on a single street. Mong Kok has entire streets and street sections dedicated to the sale of goldfish, flowers, birds, sneakers, and kitchenware. Just about everything from bargain household objects to luxury jewellery is bought, sold and haggled over in Mong Kok. Sai Yeung Choi Street sells electronics, cosmetics and clothes; Shantung Street and Dundas Street are where you can pick up the latest Japanese and Western fashion and accessories; while Langham Place is one of the many malls where you can do your Mong Kok shopping in air-conditioned comfort.

neighborhood_overview: Mong Kok is one of Hong Kong's liveliest districts and includes popular markets, shopping streets, stalls and malls. The neon-bathed historic streets that wind through one of the densest parts of the world are worth visiting.  The neighbourhood includes one of Hong Kong’s most popular markets, the Ladies' Market, and also has a ton of shopping streets, which are a common feature in southern China. Conveniently, these are where a cluster of merchants sell one type of product on a single street. Mong Kok has entire streets and street sections dedicated to the sale of goldfish, flowers, birds, sneakers, and kitchenware. ･Sai Yeung Choi Street sells electronics, cosmetics and clothes. ･Shantung Street and Dundas Street are where you can pick up the latest Japanese and Western fashion and accessories. ･Langham Place is one of the many malls where you can do your Mong Kok shopping in air-conditioned comfort.

name: Beautiful Brooklyn Brownstone
summary: Experience classic Brooklyn brownstone living! A private bedroom with shared access to kitchen and dining room in a beautiful neighborhood within walking distance to many of Brooklyn's best offerings. We are a quick subway ride to Manhattan on multiple lines. The perfect spot for those enjoying the city by day, and who want a comfortable, friendly space to rest at night.
space: Our guest bedroom is up one flight of stairs, and comes fully furnished with a queen-size bed (very comfy memory-foam mattress), dresser, bookshelves, and a 47" LED flatscreen (plus towels & sheets). There are two windows overlooking a luscious and green backyard, and receives beautiful light. Our apartment is the upper two floors of a classic brownstone on a quiet block in a historic neighborhood near downtown Brooklyn. Lots of original detail intact throughout the apartment, with charming (nonworking) fireplaces in each room. The full apartment spans two floors and is about 1600 square feet of space (two bedrooms, plus a nursery, kitchen, dining room, and living room). It is an original Brooklyn brownstone, built at the turn of the century. We’ve put a lot of work into furnishing it tastefully and adding a lot of greenery -- it’s a very peaceful space to visit.

We live in a two-family brownstone in a very safe neighborhood. Nearby are lots of fun bars, restaurants, and cafes along the more commercial streets of DeKalb Avenue, Lafayette Street, and Fulton Street. Dining options include wine bars, live jazz lounges, Ethiopian/Thai/Indian/Japanese restaurants, and beer gardens.

We are also close to the DeKalb station (Q/R/B/D) which is only one stop to Manhattan.
access: The apartment has a shared kitchen where you are welcome to make meals or just grab a cup of coffee in the morning. We also have a dining room you are welcome to use at your leisure. There is a shared full bathroom with shower & tub between the guest bedroom and our bedroom.
interaction: We are a married couple with a toddler daughter (Ryan) and friendly french bulldog (Frank) who will both happily greet you at the door. We are originally from the Midwest and Malaysia respectively, but have lived in New York City for over 15 years (with a recent 3 year stay in Burma). We've hosted on Airbnb and been Airbnb guests many times around the world, and love to meet new people. We adore our neighborhood in Fort Greene and are always happy to help with visit suggestions and finding fun things to do.
house_rules: - There is a small kitchen and dining room for shared use, though please no cooking meat. - No smoking inside the house or on the stoop. Guests may smoke on the sidewalk outside the house. - No shoes inside please.

neighborhood_overview: Kauai's North Shore is possibly the most beautiful spot on Earth! Come enjoy its golf courses, bike/walking path, secluded beaches, and sunset views. Outdoor activities abound-- hike, bike, kayak, zipline, horseback ride to a waterfall, windsurf, snorkel, stand up paddle board, take surf lessons, or just grab a beach chair, sink your toes into the sand and take it all in!

During the late spring and summer months, in addition to the ceiling fan in the living room, a standing fan and a table fan are available for your use. Please turn them off when not in the condo. notes: The 20 acre retreat is within the Puna Forest Reserve and our grounds are surrounded by rainforest that is part of the retreat.  Hawaiian Natives own  the non-private property within the reserve to protect the Native Ohia forest that is sacred to them. The Ohia Forest has giant ferns, diverse species of orchids, epiphytic plants,  strawberry guava, passion fruit, geckos, praying mantis and songbirds. Se você olhar para o mar, o Leme estará à sua esquerda, no final da praia, depois da Av. Princesa Isabel. Copacabana, carinhosamente chamado de Copa pelos cariocas, é um bairro nobre situado na Zona Sul da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, no Brasil. É considerado por muitos um dos bairros mais famosos e prestigiados do Brasil e um dos mais conhecidos do mundo. Tem o apelido de Princesinha do Mar e Coração da Zona Sul. Faz divisa com os também bairros nobres da Lagoa, Ipanema, Botafogo e é contínuo ao Leme. Things move at a slower pace without a skyscraper or stoplight in sight. Many residents still practice traditional Hawaiian customs, including warm hospitality. The small town of Kaunakakai has everything you need with a large dose of small town charm. Head to Kanemitsu bakery for a tasty brunch or late at night in the back alley for their famous hot bread - the perfect late night sweet treat. Molokai Pizza Cafe and Molokai Burger serve up familiar foods as well as local specials. Pick up groceries and other essentials at Friendly Market or Misaki’s. Souvenir shop in all of the locally owned businesses in town. If you’d rather explore the great outdoors, Molokai has everything an adventurer needs. The island has beautiful hikes, pristine waterfalls, incredible views and spectacular beaches without the crowds. From the hot and sunny west side to the lush and green east side

neighborhood_overview: Maroubra is roughly 10km from the centre of Sydney, in the Eastern Suburbs. We have lived in the area for around 6 years, and we absolutely love it! It has a great community atmosphere and it's hard to walk down the street to the beach without running into people we know. We know and love lots of the cafe and restaurant owners in the area, and have made friends with lots of the neighbours.  The beach is the highlight of the area, and it's right across the street! Maroubra beach is 1km long and is popular for surfing, swimming, a BBQ, a nice spot to sit and have lunch/dinner or just a walk to get some fresh air, space and relax. It's less crowded than its neighbour up in Bondi, but no less beautiful. To the south end there is a reserve with no buildings or houses, so it's particularly beautiful looking down the sand and waves to the trees and headland. The neighbourhood is richly cultural, from the diversity of people walking its streets to street parties, human towers, live music and fireworks, a wide variety of restaurants, and cinemas, theatres and galleries. The unique architecture also adds a charm of its own. The narrow streets, little squares and small buildings are reminiscent of the town it used to be, but the spectrum of restaurants, bars, shops and cinemas betray its status as a part of Barcelona, Catalunya’s capital city. Gracia offers the choice of quiet sleepy side streets alongside the life and bustle of its squares.

neighborhood_overview: What Hong Kong people called "the food street", people often come here all the way just to try out many of these famous restaurants - a lot of korean and japanese food opened by Koreans and Japanese themselves, also hotdog, burger, Chinese "yum cha" restaurant, Chinese dim sum, Chinese hotpot, Hong Kong local fast food, 24-hours opened noodle shop... anything you want! A market nearby if you wish to buy ingredients and cook yourself as well. This is a neighborhood where you can find old and new blend in very well with each other - where you can find really cheap food, at the same time expensive or newly opened fusion restaurants. Of course, not only food, there are 3 supermarkets nearby, a famous Guanyin temple (good for career blessing), 10 mins walk to the habor (where people exercises in that area too)... basically it is a super convenient neighborhood in Hong Kong (not to mention how it is located in the centre of Hong Kong, just one station next to Tsim Sha Tsui, or Mongkok.
notes: The room will only be available till 23 Sep, before my mum comes back from the States. And all the wardrobe are full, but if you need, you can always put your luggage in the living area, if you don't want to put them in your room. Female preferred. And the room can only accommodate 1  person max.
transit: Apart from Mongkok, I would say it's probably one of the most convenient areas in Hong Kong to travel to anywhere you want to. There is a bus travelling directing from the airport to the building, a taxi station in another direction, 3 mins walk from the building, a mini-bus right at the entrance of the building, which will take you to the metro and Tsim Sha Tsui or Kowloon Tong.  Hung Hom, where the building is located, is also the area where all bus between Hong Kong Island and Kowloon side will pass by - so it is usually a 30 mins bus ride (max) from here to places like Causeway Bay and Central. Oh, and you can also travel to Hong Kong Island by ferry! If you are trying to visit the New Territories like Tuen Mun or Yuen Long for some great hike or organic farm day trip, you can take West Rail for less than an hour and you will be at your destination. neighborhood_overview: Upscale and quiet neighborhood. Listen to the sound of the ocean , watch tropical birds in your yard and pick some fresh fruits. The views are stunning. Surfing is the best in the world during the winter. Swimming, diving, snorkeling, hiking spots, amazing sunset views are just some of the gifts of staying on the North Shore.  Can you walk to the beaches?  Yes, you easily could, but I recommend taking your rental car. There is so much to see around the neighborhood, so many restaurants, food trucks, parks, stores, the beach with the turtles - parking is free and easy.  The shoreline with a large Foodland Supermarket and a Coffee Bean Store, Pupukea Beach and Sharks Cove is less than a mile. notes: This is a true and very safe residential home and a local country neighborhood. People are friendly and the Aloha spirit governs here.  Feel free to jog around the neighborhood. The Northshore and Hawaii, in general  is beautiful and green, it means we have rain, but mostly in the evening or during the night. It's important to keep the front door and bug screens closed to keep pest including mice out of the home. neighborhood_overview: Location: Located at the south end of Lahaina town and short bike ride to Lahaina`s famous Front Street that includes the harbor, shopping, art galleries and restaurants and Banyan tree square. Located a short walking distance to the charming 505 Front Street shopping center that has unique shops, award winning restaurants, convenience store, and the Polynesian Luau `The Feast at Lele`. ½ mile stretch of beach is right in front of the property! (Please note that Puamana`s sandy beach is seasonal.) You can surf right out front of Puamana, or head down the road to 505 Beach and surf Breakwall and Harbors surf breaks. Puamana Beach park is right next door and Launiupoko beach park is within 2-5 minutes drive—both offer beginner to intermediate surf breaks. Just minutes from Ka`anapali beach resort area, world-class golf courses and the renowned Kapalua resort (can take the $2 Maui Bus). 20 minutes from Kapalua Airport & 45 minutes from Kahului airport.
notes: Puamana Resort requires a $10/day resort fee which includes daily parking for one vehicle and use of the resort facilities (tennis courts, swimming pools, and clubhouse).  This fee is included in your nightly rate.  You will need to register you car at the Office in the Clubhouse.
transit: You can walk to most attractions within Lahaina and on Front Street! If you do want to travel around the island, the nearest Maui bus stop is at the Wharf Center or you can easily work with a local taxi or car rental company for transportation needs.
access: Guests will have access to the 3 pools in the community with gate access codes.  Tennis courts are available for use with sign-up sheets in the Clubhouse *rules apply.  The Clubhouse gym is available $10/day+tax or $25/week+tax; a $20 cash deposit for the key is collected at the Clubhouse office.
interaction: We do most of our interaction through emails and phone calls but we are also on property every day. We also provide different ways to contact us, as we want to be accessible if you have any questions before or during your stay! We try to make checking in and out as easy as possible. When you make a reservation with us, we will send you a door code specific for your reservation and condo unit two weeks prior to your stay. You do not have to worry about losing a key or having to check in at a front desk!
